proofs.text: Run the status report over a project with one feature at the gate `passed` and read the header line; verify it names Rules, Spec, Tests and Run and neither Strength nor Signed, that the feature's row carries `1 passed` and that its strength is not printed; then run it at `strong` and verify Strength and Strong appear and the strength reads `n/a`, and at `signed` and verify Signed appears too
Run the status report over this repository's own specs; verify the output carries the `Spec` and `Tests` columns, that a row names a count of rules, and that its last line opens with the arrow

rule_text: The status table is one row per feature under the columns Feature, Rules, Spec, Tests and Run, with Strength and Strong added at the gate `strong` and Signed added at `signed`, and a feature with no record shows its strength as `n/a`

tests.name: test_the_columns_scale_with_the_gate

tests.body:
def test_the_repository_own_specs_print_the_table(self):
        text = purlin_status.sync_status(PROJECT_ROOT)
        header = next(line for line in text.splitlines()
                      if line.startswith('Feature'))
        assert 'Spec' in header and 'Tests' in header, header
        assert any('ready' in line for line in text.splitlines()), text
        assert text.rstrip().splitlines()[-1].startswith('→'), text
tests.name: test_the_repository_own_specs_print_the_table
